headline: Colombian Startups Lead Country in Artificial Intelligence Adoption
summary: A study by Strand Partners for Amazon Web Services showed that the share of Colombian startups using artificial intelligence rose to range between 42% and higher, outpacing other companies in the country.
why: Technology adoption rates among emerging enterprises serve as key indicators for regional digital transformation and cloud service demand.

impacts.name: Technology
impacts.why: Higher AI adoption rates drive demand for cloud computing and related technology services.
